title: olearia virgata subsp. serpentina
intro: Olearia virgata subsp. serpentina, commonly known as the Coastal Daisy Bush, is a flowering plant native to Australia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Olearia virgata subsp. serpentina include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
